title: Potential Targets and Bioactive Constituents of Daying Decoction in Schizophrenia with Neuroinflammation: A Preliminary Exploratory Integrative Study.
authors: Guo, Lina; Zhang, Bilin; Liu, Meiying; Qin, Yuxi; Lu, Hongxiao; Wang, Ze; Yuan, Yiting; Zheng, Qian; Zhao, Guang; Qiao, Yanan; Ma, Ruodi; Lu, Bocheng; Li, Yunlan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学与分子动力学模拟研究中药大营汤靶向转录因子c-JUN治疗精神分裂症神经炎症，虽涉及TF-DNA相关靶点与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合机制，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Schizophrenia (SZ) is a serious disorder often linked to schizophrenia-related neuroinflammation (SZNI). While second-generation antipsychotics (SGAs) are available, their metabolic side effects highlight the need for alternative therapies. The traditional Chinese medicine compound Daying Decoction (DYD) has shown good clinical efficacy in the treatment of SZNI, but its molecular mechanisms and pharmacological targets are not well understood. There are also no studies that have yet reported their interaction with SZNI. METHODS: To find out how DYD might help with SZNI, we used bioinformatics tools to analyze things like gene activity, immune cell presence, and key gene patterns. We also did lab tests-including molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and experiments in cell cultures-to check how the main active parts of DYD affect important genes. RESULTS: We identified, through bioinformatics analysis, that the transcription factor c-JUN may act as a key regulator in SZNI, and that rhein may serve as a core component. Molecular dynamics simulations and CETSA further confirmed the substantial structural stability of the c-JUN-Rhein complex. Finally, in vitro analyses indicated that rhein effectively reduced ROS levels and modulated neuroinflammatory biomarkers by inhibiting JNK/c-JUN phosphorylation and inflammatory factors. CONCLUSION: We conducted the first comprehensive study of DYD against SZNI, identifying that c-JUN might represent a candidate that could be explored as a potential therapeutic target and that rhein may contribute as a core active component. This serves as a starting point that can guide future in vivo studies and the development of potential small-molecule therapies for SZNI.
abstract_zh: 目的：精神分裂症（SZ）是一种严重的精神障碍，常与精神分裂症相关神经炎症（SZNI）相关联。尽管第二代抗精神病药物（SGAs）可用，但其代谢副作用凸显了对替代疗法的需求。中药复方大营汤（DYD）在治疗SZNI方面显示出良好的临床疗效，但其分子机制和药理学靶点尚不明确，且尚无研究报道其与SZNI的相互作用。方法：为探究DYD对SZNI的潜在作用，我们利用生物信息学工具分析了基因活性、免疫细胞存在及关键基因模式等方面。我们还进行了实验室测试——包括分子对接、分子动力学模拟及细胞培养实验——以验证DYD主要活性成分对重要基因的影响。结果：通过生物信息学分析，我们确定转录因子c-JUN可能作为SZNI中的关键调控因子，而大黄酸（rhein）可能作为核心成分。分子动力学模拟和CETSA进一步证实了c-JUN-大黄酸复合物具有显著的结构稳定性。最后，体外分析表明，大黄酸通过抑制JNK/c-JUN磷酸化及炎症因子，有效降低了ROS水平并调节了神经炎症生物标志物。结论：我们首次对DYD抗SZNI进行了全面研究，确定c-JUN可能作为潜在治疗靶点的候选分子，大黄酸可能作为核心活性成分。这为未来体内研究及开发针对SZNI的潜在小分子疗法提供了起点。
